title: Bharata informs Rama about Dasaratha's death
introduction: Rama asks Bharata why he has come to the forest, wearing robes of bark and antelope skin, abandoning Ayodhya kingdom. Bharata informs Rama about Dasaratha's death and requests Rama to take over the kingdom, endowed to him as per succession. Rama says that since king Dasaratha allotted two different duties to the two of them one enjoining the exile of his elder brother being binding on him and the other bequeathing the kingdom to Bharata, they must be implicitly obeyed by both of them.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोत्तरशततमः सर्गः
Thus completes 101st Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तम् तु रामः समाश्वास्य भ्रातरम् गुरु वत्सलम् |
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा प्रष्टुम् समुपचक्रमे
verses.iast:
tam tu rāmaḥ samāśvāsya bhrātaram guru vatsalam |
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā praṣṭum samupacakrame
verses.translation: Rama along with Lakshmana, his younger brother, began to question Bharata, his brother who was devoted to elders (as follows):

glosses.meaning: who was devoted to his elders.

verses.devanagari:
किम् एतद् इग्च्छेयम् अहम् श्रोतुम् प्रव्याहृतम् त्वया |
यस्मात् त्वम् आगतो देशम् इमम् चीर जटा अजिनी
verses.iast:
kim etad igccheyam aham śrotum pravyāhṛtam tvayā |
yasmāt tvam āgato deśam imam cīra jaṭā ajinī
verses.translation: "I desire to hear from you, why you have come tot his place in robes of bark and an antelope-skin."

glosses.meaning: in robes of bark and an antelope-skin.

verses.devanagari:
किम् निमित्तम् इमम् देशम् कृष्ण अजिन जटा धरः |
हित्वा राज्यम् प्रविष्टः त्वम् तत् सर्वम् वक्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
kim nimittam imam deśam kṛṣṇa ajina jaṭā dharaḥ |
hitvā rājyam praviṣṭaḥ tvam tat sarvam vaktum arhasi
verses.translation: "You ought to tell me all about the purpose for which you entered this place, clad in deer-skin and matted hair, relinquishing the kingdom."

glosses.meaning: clad in deer-skin and matted hair

verses.devanagari:
इत्य् उक्तः केकयी पुत्रः काकुत्स्थेन महात्मना |
प्रगृह्य बलवद् भूयः प्रान्जलिर् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
ity uktaḥ kekayī putraḥ kākutsthena mahātmanā |
pragṛhya balavad bhūyaḥ prānjalir vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Thus questioned by the high souled Rama, by closely embracing him again, Bharata with joined palms answered as follows:

verses.devanagari:
आर्यम् तातः परित्यज्य कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम् |
गतः स्वर्गम् महा बाहुः पुत्र शोक अभिपीडितः
verses.iast:
āryam tātaḥ parityajya kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram |
gataḥ svargam mahā bāhuḥ putra śoka abhipīḍitaḥ
verses.translation: "O, noble brother! Our father the mighty armed, after performing a deed must difficult to perform, and having abandoned us has gone the divine region; he died of grief on account of separation from his son."

glosses.meaning: with grief caused by separation from him son.

verses.devanagari:
स्त्रिया नियुक्तः कैकेय्या मम मात्रा परम् तप |
चकार सुमहत् पापम् इदम् आत्म यशो हरम्
verses.iast:
striyā niyuktaḥ kaikeyyā mama mātrā param tapa |
cakāra sumahat pāpam idam ātma yaśo haram
verses.translation: "O, tormented of foes! As urged by his wife and my mother Kaikeyi;, our father committed this great sin that has taken away his own reputation."

glosses.meaning: that has taken away his own reputation.

verses.devanagari:
सा राज्य फलम् अप्राप्य विधवा शोक कर्शिता |
पतिष्यति महा घोरे निरये जननी मम
verses.iast:
sā rājya phalam aprāpya vidhavā śoka karśitā |
patiṣyati mahā ghore niraye jananī mama
verses.translation: "Without having plucked the fruit of kingdom, widowed and emaciated with grief my mother will fall into the most terrific hell."

verses.devanagari:
तस्य मे दास भूतस्य प्रसादम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि |
अभिषिन्चस्व च अद्य एव राज्येन मघवान् इव
verses.iast:
tasya me dāsa bhūtasya prasādam kartum arhasi |
abhiṣincasva ca adya eva rājyena maghavān iva
verses.translation: "Grant me, who am your true servant, a favour! This very day, as Indra the Lord of celestials himself, receive the royal anointing!"

glosses.meaning: like Devendra the Lord of celestials.

verses.devanagari:
इमाः प्रकृतयः सर्वा विधवा मातुरः च याः |
त्वत् सकाशम् अनुप्राप्ताः प्रसादम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
imāḥ prakṛtayaḥ sarvā vidhavā māturaḥ ca yāḥ |
tvat sakāśam anuprāptāḥ prasādam kartum arhasi
verses.translation: "Grant all these people and these widowed Queens, who have come here to see you, this felicity!"

verses.devanagari:
तदा आनुपूर्व्या युक्तम् च युक्तम् च आत्मनि मानद |
राज्यम् प्राप्नुहि धर्मेण सकामान् सुहृदः कुरु
verses.iast:
tadā ānupūrvyā yuktam ca yuktam ca ātmani mānada |
rājyam prāpnuhi dharmeṇa sakāmān suhṛdaḥ kuru
verses.translation: "O, Prince! For that reason, accept the throne that is befitting; endowed to you as per succession and that is yours by right fulfill, as your should, the desires of your friends."

verses.devanagari:
भवतु अविधवा भूमिः समग्रा पतिना त्वया |
शशिना विमलेन इव शारदी रजनी यथा
verses.iast:
bhavatu avidhavā bhūmiḥ samagrā patinā tvayā |
śaśinā vimalena iva śāradī rajanī yathā
verses.translation: "Bring the widowhood of the entire world to an end by becoming her Lord, as does the immaculate moon to the autumn-night."

verses.devanagari:
एभिः च सचिवैः सार्धम् शिरसा याचितो मया |
भ्रातुः शिष्यस्य दासस्य प्रसादम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
ebhiḥ ca sacivaiḥ sārdham śirasā yācito mayā |
bhrātuḥ śiṣyasya dāsasya prasādam kartum arhasi
verses.translation: "Grant this grace to your brother, who prostrates at your feet along with your ministers is both your discipline and your slave."

verses.devanagari:
तद् इदम् शाश्वतम् पित्र्यम् सर्वम् सचिव मण्डलम् |
पूजितम् पुरुष व्याघ्र न अतिक्रमितुम् उत्सहे
verses.iast:
tad idam śāśvatam pitryam sarvam saciva maṇḍalam |
pūjitam puruṣa vyāghra na atikramitum utsahe
verses.translation: "O, Tiger among men! You cannot disregard this unbroken kingdom, which is eternal, ancestral and honoured."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्त्वा महा बाहुः सबाष्पः केकयी सुतः |
रामस्य शिरसा पादौ जग्राह भरतः पुनः
verses.iast:
evam uktvā mahā bāhuḥ sabāṣpaḥ kekayī sutaḥ |
rāmasya śirasā pādau jagrāha bharataḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Thus speaking, the mighty armed Bharata, with tears, once again seized Rama's feet in great honour, as per precept.

verses.devanagari:
तम् मत्तम् इव मातन्गम् निह्श्वसन्तम् पुनः पुनः |
भ्रातरम् भरतम् रामः परिष्वज्य इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tam mattam iva mātangam nihśvasantam punaḥ punaḥ |
bhrātaram bharatam rāmaḥ pariṣvajya idam abravīt
verses.translation: Rama embraced his brother Bharata, who sighed again and again like an elephant in rut, and spoke as follows:-

verses.devanagari:
कुलीनः सत्त्व सम्पन्नः तेजस्वी चरित व्रतः |
राज्य हेतोः कथम् पापम् आचरेत् त्वद् विधो जनः
verses.iast:
kulīnaḥ sattva sampannaḥ tejasvī carita vrataḥ |
rājya hetoḥ katham pāpam ācaret tvad vidho janaḥ
verses.translation: "How should a man of noble birth, rich in Sattva (goodness), dignified and who has observed sacred vows like myself, commit sin for the sake of a mere kingdom?"

glosses.meaning: and who has observed sacred vows
for the sake of a mere kingdom?

verses.devanagari:
न दोषम् त्वयि पश्यामि सूक्ष्मम् अप्य् अरि सूदन |
न च अपि जननीम् बाल्यात् त्वम् विगर्हितुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
na doṣam tvayi paśyāmi sūkṣmam apy ari sūdana |
na ca api jananīm bālyāt tvam vigarhitum arhasi
verses.translation: "O, Bharata the annihilator of enemies! I do not see the slightest fault in you and you should not reproach your mother for a childish action."

verses.devanagari:
कामकरो महाप्राअज्ञ गुरूणां सर्वदानघ |
उपपन्नेषु दारेषु पुत्रेषु च विधीयते
verses.iast:
kāmakaro mahāprāajJṇa gurūṇāṃ sarvadānagha |
upapanneṣu dāreṣu putreṣu ca vidhīyate
verses.translation: "O, Bharata the highly intelligent and the faultless man! It is incumbent always on the part of the elders to act freely with reference to their wives and progeny."

glosses.meaning: on the part of the elders

verses.devanagari:
वयमस्य यथा लोके संख्याताः सुअम्य साधुभिः |
भार्याः पुत्राश्च शिष्याश्छ त्वमनुज्ञातुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
vayamasya yathā loke saṅkhyātāḥ suamya sādhubhiḥ |
bhāryāḥ putrāśca śiṣyāścha tvamanujJṇātumarhasi
verses.translation: "O, gentle brother! Since it was said thus by virtuous men in this world, we should all, women children and disciples, obey our Lord; this must be known to you."

verses.devanagari:
वने वा चीरवसनं सौम्यकृष्णाजिनाम्बरम् |
राज्ये वापि महाराजो मां वासयितुमीश्वरः
verses.iast:
vane vā cīravasanaṃ saumyakṛṣṇājināmbaram |
rājye vāpi mahārājo māṃ vāsayitumīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: "The great king is the master, who has a discretion either to make me reside in the forest, wearing bark robes and a black antelope skin or to sit on the throne, O gentle brother!"

glosses.meaning: who may either make me reside
or to sit on the throne

verses.devanagari:
यावत् पितरि धर्मज्न गौरवम् लोक सत्कृते |
तावद् धर्मभृताम् श्रेष्ठ जनन्याम् अपि गौरवम्
verses.iast:
yāvat pitari dharmajna gauravam loka satkṛte |
tāvad dharmabhṛtām śreṣṭha jananyām api gauravam
verses.translation: "O, excellent among the supporters of law and the virtuous! The same degree of respect is to be paid to our mother, as is due to our father, who is honoured by all."

glosses.meaning: who was honoured by the world.

verses.devanagari:
एताभ्याम् धर्म शीलाभ्याम् वनम् गग्च्छ इति राघव |
माता पितृभ्याम् उक्तो अहम् कथम् अन्यत् समाचरे
verses.iast:
etābhyām dharma śīlābhyām vanam gagccha iti rāghava |
mātā pitṛbhyām ukto aham katham anyat samācare
verses.translation: "How can I do otherwise, while both my parents of virtuous nature ask me to go to the forest?"

glosses.meaning: by both my mother and father

verses.devanagari:
त्वया राज्यम् अयोध्यायाम् प्राप्तव्यम् लोक सत्कृतम् |
वस्तव्यम् दण्डक अरण्ये मया वल्कल वाससा
verses.iast:
tvayā rājyam ayodhyāyām prāptavyam loka satkṛtam |
vastavyam daṇḍaka araṇye mayā valkala vāsasā
verses.translation: "It is for you to occupy the throne in Ayodhya that the world reveres and it is for me to occupy this Dandaka forest, wearing bark robes."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् कृत्वा महा राजो विभागम् लोक सम्निधौ |
व्यादिश्य च महा तेजा दिवम् दशरथो गतः
verses.iast:
evam kṛtvā mahā rājo vibhāgam loka samnidhau |
vyādiśya ca mahā tejā divam daśaratho gataḥ
verses.translation: "Having commanded thus, the emperor Dasaratha with a great splendour, made the division of duties in this manner (for us two) in the presence of the people and then ascended to heaven."

glosses.meaning: in the presence of the people

verses.devanagari:
स च प्रमाणम् धर्म आत्मा राजा लोक गुरुः तव |
पित्रा दत्तम् यथा भागम् उपभोक्तुम् त्वम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
sa ca pramāṇam dharma ātmā rājā loka guruḥ tava |
pitrā dattam yathā bhāgam upabhoktum tvam arhasi
verses.translation: "That pious souled king, the preceptor of the world is the standard authority for you and you have to enjoy the share given by our father accordingly."

glosses.meaning: and the preceptor of the world

verses.devanagari:
चतुर्दश समाः सौम्य दण्डक अरण्यम् आश्रितः |
उपभोक्ष्ये तु अहम् दत्तम् भागम् पित्रा महात्मना
verses.iast:
caturdaśa samāḥ saumya daṇḍaka araṇyam āśritaḥ |
upabhokṣye tu aham dattam bhāgam pitrā mahātmanā
verses.translation: "I, for my part, shall enjoy the share given to me by our high-souled father for fourteen years, taking my abode in Dandaka forest, O gentle brother!"
